name: giant toad
desc: Giant Toad is a CR 1 beast.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target is &Reference[grappled] (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is &Reference[restrained], and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't [[lookup @item.name lowercase]] another target.

actions.name: swallow
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .lYSWskOMRCVLyWLZ]]{Bite} attack against a Medium or smaller target it is &reference[grappling]. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is &reference[blinded] and &reference[restrained], it has &reference[total cover] against attacks and other effects outside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, and it takes [[/damage average activity=hjeShYMsNTvN1QF9]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have only one target swallowed at a time. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting &reference[prone].

actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

actions.name: standing leap
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s &reference[long jump] is up to 20 feet and its &reference[high jump] is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.
